{{Description|"Fairies focus on the small and common things and make them magically powerful. Affiliating yourself with the Fairy faction will hugely improve the output of lower tier buildings."}}

== The Fairy Faction ==
[[File:Fairychampion.png|left|54x54px|Fairy Champion Trophy]]
[[File:Fairy Choir.png|right|54x54px|Fairy Choir]]
The '''Fairies''' are one of the original [[Alignments|Good Vanilla Factions]] that was implemented since the beginning of the game. They can cheaply build the first 3 Tier [[buildings]], thus boosting perks based on amount of buildings, and help get some of the [[Trophies#Buildings|building trophy series]]. With their spell upgrade Fairy Choir, they can magically multiply the amount of [[assistants]], which combined with other perks can become a very strong asset.
* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''''Good'''''
* '''[[Alignment#Leges|Leges]]''': '''''Chaos'''''
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''': '''''Fairy Chanting''''' - Increase the production of Farms, Inns and Blacksmiths by x500 for 10 seconds.
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''': '''''Fairy Choir''''' - Triples your assistants while Fairy Chanting is active.
** Unlock requirement: Cast the Fairy Chanting spell while having 45 or more assistants.
* '''[[Heritage]]''': Increase the production of all buildings by 0.075% per Farm, Inn and Blacksmith you own.
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': Increase the production of Farm, Inn and Blacksmith based on the assistants you own.
** {{Formula|build|250 \times x^{0.9}%|assistants}}
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''': '''''Fairy Orchestra''''' - Each assistant generates 3 times as many Faction Coins while Fairy Chanting is active.
* '''[[Unique Buildings|Research Building]]''': '''''Enchanted Fields''''' (from Farms)
* '''[[Research#The Facilities & Related Factions|Research Facility]]''': '''''Spellcraft'''''
* '''[[Unique Buildings|Leges Building]]''': '''''Swarming Towers''''' (from Wizard Towers)
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': None (All Vanilla Factions are unlocked by default)

== Unique Buildings ==
[[File:Fairy Unique Building Design.png|left]]
[[File:Special-building-fairy.png|right|190x190px]][[File:Swarming Tower.png|right|190x190px]]
At R16, the Fairies' ''Farms'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Enchanted Fields''''', which is required for some [[challenges]] and [[research]] quests.

At R100, the Fairies' ''Wizard Towers'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Swarming Towers''''', which when bought will grant access to the [[Faction Union]] upgrade.

{{Clr}}

== Fairy Research ==
[[File:Research-new-progress-system-msg.PNG|right|250px]]
Upon reaching R16, the game advisor tells us that the Vanilla factions have gained tremendous power. Their power can be ours if we get ready and seek them again.

To unlock Fairy research, play the Fairy faction and simply follow the appearing quests (Do not [[prestige]]). These can be done in separate game plays.
